## Note on letters of support

These are the single most common cause of a missed deadline, because they
depend on other people. Request them **three weeks out**, not one. Send each
partner a draft they can edit — a court administrator will sign a good draft
far faster than they will write one.

Standing partners to approach: [[PLACEHOLDER: named contacts at NJ recovery
courts, IDRC, care management organizations, treatment providers]]
